normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS- Short walk to the beach - Event Friendly- Low-Speed Vehicle- Extended Heated Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day**- Game room- Private balconies with scenic views- Nearby dining and shopping- 13 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: For Shore, a luxurious home in the exclusive Blue Mountain Beach community, is 6 minutes from the beach with Emerald Coast views. Spanning over 5,000 square feet, this spacious retreat sleeps up to 30 guests with 13 beautifully-appointed bedrooms and 10.5 bathrooms. Ideal for retreats, weddings, and other special events, For Shore offers a luxurious setting with a lovely pool and outdoor area for unforgettable gatherings.This 4-story coastal haven features a spacious outdoor entertainment area with a pristine green turf backyard—a versatile space that can be easily rearranged to suit any event. Barbeque on the natural gas grill, dine alfresco at the 6-person table, watch the kids splash in the pool, or sunbathe on the 4 loungers. Retire to the first-floor guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom—or hang out in the climate-controlled garage that doubles as a game room with a billiards table, foosball table, and TV. Beyond the laundry room with 3 washer and dryers, the in-home elevator takes guests to any of the four floors.The main floor is the heart of the home—soft sunlight illuminates the spacious great room. A grandiose table seats 30 guests and turns any dinner party into an unforgettable celebration. The kitchen was designed for large parties, offering abundant cabinetry, counter space, and high-end appliances, including 2 refrigerators and 2 microwaves. The living area has 2 spacious sectionals and an impressive 86" TV, and the theater room's 75" TV and 7-person couch are great for casual lounging and movie nights.The third floor, designated for sleeping, features a primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony access, alongside a bunk room with a full-over-full bed and 4 guest bedrooms—2 of these bedrooms have private bathrooms, 3 have king beds, and the last has a queen bed.The fourth-floor bedrooms mirror the third-floor layout, boasting a primary bedroom, 4 guest bedrooms, and a bunk room. All bedrooms throughout the home have TVs.For Shore is the ultimate paradise for large gatherings along the Emerald Coast and offers on-site parking for 6 vehicles, 13 adult bikes, and a 6-passenger golf cart. Book this unforgettable home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 30):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Handicap Accessible Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bathroom: Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full/Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyFOURTH FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full/Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*This home can accommodate corporate retreats/meetings, family reunions, weddings, and other events.*This home is pet-friendly with an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax. body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Blue Mountain Beach "For Shore" 59 Brentwood Lane Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-115550 Bedrooms 13 Beds 15 Sleeps 30 Full Baths 10 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS - Short walk to the beach - Event Friendly - Low-Speed Vehicle - Extended Heated Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day** - Game room - Private balconies with scenic views - Nearby dining and shopping - 13 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: For Shore, a luxurious home in the exclusive Blue Mountain Beach community, is 6 minutes from the beach with Emerald Coast views. Spanning over 5,000 square feet, this spacious retreat sleeps up to 30 guests with 13 beautifully-appointed bedrooms and 10.5 bathrooms. Ideal for retreats, weddings, and other special events, For Shore offers a luxurious setting with a lovely pool and outdoor area for unforgettable gatherings. This 4-story coastal haven features a spacious outdoor entertainment area with a pristine green turf backyard—a versatile space that can be easily rearranged to suit any event. Barbeque on the natural gas grill, dine alfresco at the 6-person table, watch the kids splash in the pool, or sunbathe on the 4 loungers. Retire to the first-floor guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom—or hang out in the climate-controlled garage that doubles as a game room with a billiards table, foosball table, and TV. Beyond the laundry room with 3 washer and dryers, the in-home elevator takes guests to any of the four floors. The main floor is the heart of the home—soft sunlight illuminates the spacious great room. A grandiose table seats 30 guests and turns any dinner party into an unforgettable celebration. The kitchen was designed for large parties, offering abundant cabinetry, counter space, and high-end appliances, including 2 refrigerators and 2 microwaves. The living area has 2 spacious sectionals and an impressive 86" TV, and the theater room's 75" TV and 7-person couch are great for casual lounging and movie nights. The third floor, designated for sleeping, features a primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony access, alongside a bunk room with a full-over-full bed and 4 guest bedrooms—2 of these bedrooms have private bathrooms, 3 have king beds, and the last has a queen bed. The fourth-floor bedrooms mirror the third-floor layout, boasting a primary bedroom, 4 guest bedrooms, and a bunk room. All bedrooms throughout the home have TVs. For Shore is the ultimate paradise for large gatherings along the Emerald Coast and offers on-site parking for 6 vehicles, 13 adult bikes, and a 6-passenger golf cart. Book this unforgettable home today!
